chunks: So follow what is sent down to you by your Lord, for homage is due to no one but God, and turn away from idolaters.

key_terms.أُوحِيَ: Divine revelation or inspiration sent down
key_terms.إِلَٰهَ: Deity or god worthy of worship
key_terms.المُشْرِكِينَ: Polytheists or those who associate partners with God

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command the Prophet to do regarding revelation and polytheists?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-An'am, this verse serves as a bridge between the detailed theological arguments against idolatry and the practical directive for the Prophet to maintain steadfastness in monotheism. Shia scholarship emphasizes this as a command for both internal conviction and external detachment from polytheistic influences, reinforcing the principle of Tawhid as the core of prophetic mission. It underscores the necessity of following divine revelation exclusively, distinguishing the believer's path from the multiplicity of false deities.
